train_translation_model: train a fairseq translation model using fconv, lstm, or transformer architecture on dummy data
train_language_model: train a fairseq language model with fconv, transformer, lstm, or lightconv architecture
train_masked_lm: train a masked language model using roberta or linformer roberta architecture
train_roberta_head: train a roberta sentence prediction or regression head on classification data
eval_lm_main: evaluate a trained language model checkpoint and compute perplexity metrics
